summary: Iteration 2 testing: logo upload (card + site), public file serving, drag&drop reorder persistence, and site duplication. Extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with 6 new tests (upload auth, upload+serve roundtrip, upload rejects non-image, duplicate happy path with clicks reset & (Kopya) suffix & published=false & domain empty, duplicate auth, duplicate 404). All 15 pytest tests pass in ~6s. Frontend Playwright: admin login OK; duplicated Demo site via duplicate-site-{id} button -> new site opens in editor with heading 'Demo Reklam Sitesi (Kopya)' and 6 cards copied; card-edit dialog logo upload via hidden card-logo-upload-input successfully uploaded and rendered img with full URL {BACKEND}/api/files/linkads/uploads/<uuid>.png; card saved; card reorder via PUT /api/sites/{id}/cards/reorder persisted and order shown after reload (verified reversed order); site-logo-upload also uploaded and rendered; site published + saved. Cleaned up the duplicated site at the end.

issues: Radix DialogContent still missing aria-describedby/Description (a11y console warning) — carried over from iteration 1.

action_items: (Optional a11y) Add DialogDescription to Card + New-Site dialogs.
critical_code_review_comments: ImageUpload builds absolute URL with API_BASE + res.data.url which is correct; ensures img renders across public routes.
SiteEditor drag&drop uses HTML5 DnD (onDragStart/Enter/End) — works but not touch-friendly; reorder API PUT /sites/{id}/cards/reorder does N sequential updates (fine for small lists).
duplicate_site copies settings by reference from the source dict; because Motor returns a new dict this is safe, but for defense a deep copy would be safer.
serve_file: if file record exists but object-store fetch fails, returns 404 — swallows real error; could log and 502.
CORS still allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True (harmless w/ JWT header, but browser will ignore credentials).
seed_data_creation: Uploaded 2 tiny 1x1 PNGs to object storage via /api/upload (linkads/uploads/*.png) that remain referenced in db.files. Duplicated site was cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three new features work end-to-end. Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (15 tests). Public URL: https://multi-domain-ads.preview.emergentagent.com. Duplicate button data-testid=duplicate-site-{id}; upload testids: card-logo-upload-btn/input and site-logo-upload-btn/input; reorder endpoint verified persistent.
